job.job_description:
Roll : Lead Agentic AI Engineer
Experience : 5+ Years

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and implement innovative AI and ML models to solve complex business problems.
Design and build scalable AI solutions using Python and relevant frameworks/libraries (Flask API, Fast API, Pandas, Scikit Learn, PyTorch, Transformer, OpenAI, Hugging face).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Conduct research and development to stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and ML.
Engage with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored AI solutions.
Lead and mentor junior team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Ensure continuous learning and development to keep up with the fast-paced AI industry.
Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI models and solutions to meet business needs.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

Proficiency in Python.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP for AI/ML/DS project development.
Experience into Agentic AI
Good understanding of ML models, Deep Learning, NLP/CV, and Generative AI concepts, Agentic AI concepts.
Good understanding of LLMs & NLP.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with rapid prototyping.
Experience with client engagement and leading teams is a plus.
Proven track record in building products/solutions using cutting-edge AI models and tools.
Ability to conduct quick R&D and continuously upscale and upskill.
